last_review.summary: The implementation satisfies AUTH-006-B and the architecture contracts. AppClient centralizes outbound HTTP, enforces relative paths and a fixed base boundary, propagates request IDs, invokes the injected auth strategy, handles JSON/empty/non-JSON bodies, preserves completed HTTP statuses, and exposes sanitized distinguishable transport errors. Changes are confined to src/app-client/, and deterministic build and Prisma validation passed.

notes: No tests are executed by loop V2.
Do not connect autonomous agents to the production Supabase database.
Core does not exist yet; Auth defines stable seams/contracts but does not implement Core.
Auth->Core internal request auth is Noop in V1; future signed JWT is a pluggable strategy.
